source_table: NO NEW MEASUREMENTS. Underlying EC50 values (mM, 4-parameter fit, 24 PFAS, 4:2 and 6:2 FTOH non-binding, H/L threshold 1.45 mM) are collected from the literature and match the Starnes dataset already in this file; logged to avoid double-counting it. Useful finding: PFAA with C7-C9 bind HSA most tightly and >C10 bind less, which corroborates the non-monotonic chain-length relationship seen independently in Fischer 2024.

source_table: REVIEW, no primary data. Mechanistic summary: the hydrophobic fluorinated chain occupies the protein binding cavity while the acid head group hydrogen-bonds to residues; chlorine substitution, ether oxygen insertion and branching change chain length and hydrophobicity and so change affinity. Recommends integrating in vitro work with in silico QSAR.
